note: Heavily wooded campground above the Duck River. The park's one-lane bridge is closed for construction, so the campground has its own entrance: take Country Club Drive, the first left north of the park entrance on US-41, and look for the campground sign about 0.4 mile along on the left. Some of the southern sites hold water after rain. --Claude
summary: TN State Parks campground confirmed: 50 sites, water + 20/30/50 A at all, no sewer, back-in asphalt pads 45-65 ft; $32-53 (stored $32-37; holiday weekends now read); dump, showers (closed Dec-Feb). Not waterfront kept. Pin inside the campground. Phone 931-723-5073 -> 931-461-7676. Bridge-closure access route kept in the note; booking/fee boilerplate stripped.
